# vendor/

Code written by other people, copied in unchanged.

## lamejs.js  (MP3 encoder)

- Package: `@breezystack/lamejs` 1.2.7 (a maintained build of **lamejs**, which is a JavaScript port of the **LAME** MP3 encoder, https://lame.sourceforge.net)
- Licence: **LGPL-3.0** (see `lamejs-LICENSE.txt` for the LAME licence note shipped with the package; the full LGPL text is at https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt)
- Used only by `src/mp3.js`, and only loaded when you choose MP3 in the Export window.

The LGPL lets this app stay MIT-licensed because lamejs is kept as a **separate, unmodified file** that you can replace with your own build. Please do not edit `lamejs.js`; replace the whole file instead.
